summary: Full e2e test of AetherXOS MVP: 23/23 backend pytest tests passed (auth, posts, changelogs, releases CRUD + ISO upload/download + sha256, analytics, admin health/logs, brute-force lockout). Frontend public pages (Home, Downloads, News, News detail, Changelog, Architecture, Docs) all render correctly. Admin login (admin@aetherxos.dev / aether123) works via cookie + Bearer token. Admin dashboard shows all 4 stat cards (Pageviews, Unique visitors, Downloads, Countries), traffic line chart, geography pie, top pages, top referrers, downloads bar chart, and time range switch (7/14/30) updates data. Admin Posts/Changelogs/Releases/System pages all load with seeded data. Releases 'Add URL' modal opens. Logout works.

minor.issue: allow_origins=['*'] combined with allow_credentials=True is a browser-spec violation; preview ingress masks it by also returning '*'. For production, set CORS_ORIGINS to explicit origin list.

issues: Recharts ResponsiveContainer logs warning 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on initial render before container measures. Cosmetic only, charts render correctly after layout settles.

action_items: (Optional/Hardening) Tighten CORS_ORIGINS to a comma-separated list of explicit origins instead of '*' when allow_credentials=True to be browser-spec compliant.
(Optional) Suppress Recharts initial-render width(-1) warning by giving ResponsiveContainer an explicit minHeight or using fixed dimensions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py mixes CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True — works only because the cloudflare/ingress layer also normalizes; browsers reject this pattern in strict mode.
Login endpoint sets cookie with secure=False — fine for local but should be True behind https in production.
Pseudo-geo via md5(ip) is documented mocked behavior — confirmed not a bug.
Public /api/analytics/track has no rate limiting — could be abused; consider per-IP throttle for production.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all pages render, all admin sections accessible, login/logout works)

seed_data_creation: Used backend's own startup seed (3 posts, 4 changelogs, 3 releases, ~30 days of analytics events). Created and cleaned up several TEST_-prefixed posts/changelogs/releases plus one fake .iso upload (deleted after test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Brute-force lockout key is ip:email so testing wrong creds repeatedly on the same admin email from the browser IP can temporarily lock the admin account from the frontend for 15 minutes. Use unique emails for lockout tests (as test_aetherxos.py does). Login from frontend works end-to-end; CORS headers come from the ingress in this preview env and include both 'access-control-allow-origin: *' and 'access-control-allow-credentials: true' which works in Chromium-based browsers used by Playwright but may not in stricter browsers.
rca of the issue: No persistent bugs found. Initial frontend run showed login appearing to fail; root cause was that a previous wrong-password attempt in the same test session combined with prior testing had pushed the ip:email counter near lockout, and on retry the login succeeded as confirmed by 200 response, set-cookie, localStorage aether_token, redirect to /admin and full dashboard render.
